about_the_game:
In this game, you’ll embark on an exciting journey with unique characters, including a nurse, office worker, waiter, flight attendant, and teacher. Each level becomes more challenging as you solve intricate puzzles, restore images, and uncover captivating stories.

Features:

  • 100 unique levels: Each level presents a new challenge with original characters and intriguing puzzles.

  • Increased difficulty: The game has become significantly more challenging — solving puzzles now requires more time and attention, making the experience more engaging and rewarding.

  • Variety of characters: Dive into the stories of a nurse, office worker, waiter, flight attendant, and teacher, solving puzzles related to their professions.

  • Captivating gameplay: As the difficulty increases, you’ll be hooked by the challenge, making each solution a true accomplishment.

  • Engaging images: Restoring images brings satisfaction and a sense of achievement, creating a relaxing atmosphere.

  • Perfect for relaxation: Enjoy the game while unwinding, immersing yourself in the captivating process without stress.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is intended exclusively for people over the age of 18. In addition, all the characters featured in this game have come of age.
This game features scenes of a sexual nature and nudity.
